name: Bullet
summary: One thin bar per measure against its target tick, over shaded ranges: many KPIs and their targets on one slide.

openxml.notes: Bands as a stacked c:barChart (gap width 0) on the primary axes, which PowerPoint draws first; the measure as a clustered c:barChart (gap width 200) on deleted secondary axes of the same scale; the target as a c:scatterChart series without markers on the measure's axes (Y the category position), whose fixed Y error bars draw a tick at each target.
